PPS.label: PPS
PPS.help: Fixed payout for every share. Zero variance, steep fees.

PPLNS.label: PPLNS
PPLNS.help: Paid according to the pool’s luck. Some variance, low fees.

SOLO.label: Solo
SOLO.help: All or nothing: you pocket a whole block when you find one.

SHADY.label: Shady
SHADY.help: Juicy bonus, paid every 6 h… unless they run off with the till.

pools.title: Pools & networks
pools.networksIntro: Every coin has an algorithm and a fixed emission per minute, split between all miners (players and NPCs). The more hashrate on a network, the less each miner earns: hunt for the under-mined one. NPCs pile in when the price pumps and bail when it dumps.

cols.profitabilityHint: Gross revenue for 1 MH/s over 24 h, before pool fees

pools.howFederations: Federations: plug rigs into 3 different pools of the same federation and every one of its pools charges you 1% less in fees. Diversifying pays.
